Type:

Syntax:
ara::core::Optional<std::uint8_t> num_lines;
Description:
std::uint8_t optional member variable which represents the IEEE1722 defined num_lines 4 bit
header field of an IEEE1722 stream with subtype RVF.
The value range for num_lines shall be:
0x00...0x0F : valid
0x10...0xFF : not used
For transmission, the value of num_lines shall be set to the configured value, if it is not provided
the application.

protected
